BiblicalUsage: Sinai is the mountain where God gives the law, and Israel comes to it in the third month after leaving Egypt. The LORD tells Moses to be ready, because on the third day He will come down in the sight of all the people. The name is the mountain of the covenant, and everything after it is measured from it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Sinai is where God becomes Israel's God in covenant, and the mountain still defines what it means to belong to Him. The law was given on a mountain that burned, and the gospel was finished on a hill where a cross stood.
